until.final_synthesis: The term 'until' reveals Christ's role as the covenantal mediator, bridging time and eternity, and fulfilling the promise of redemption through the fulfillment of time-bound covenants.
until.messianic_fulfillment: Joseph Smith's quote: 'until the day that Noah entered the ark' (Book of Mormon)
until.first_appearance: Genesis 8:5 (waters dried up until the land was fertile)
until.reveals_about_christ: Christ's fulfillment of covenantal timekeeping, intergenerational covenantal continuity, and the promise of redemption through time-bound promises
until.major_scriptural_pattern: covenantal timekeeping, paired terms (until/after), numerical patterns (595 verses)
until.literal_sense: up to, until, as in time or duration
until.symbolic_structure: paired terms (until/after), covenantal oppositions (until/after), repeated phrases (until the day...)
until.numerical_letter_observations: 595 verses across canon, 266 OT, 124 BoFM, 122 Other, 58 NT
until.semantic_range: time, duration, covenantal fulfillment, state of being until a condition is met

understand.final_synthesis: The term 'understanding' encapsulates the interplay between human limitation and divine sovereignty, reflecting Christ's dual roles as both the revealer of God's will and the transformer of hearts through spiritual insight and the indwelling Spirit.
understand.messianic_fulfillment: The term 'understanding' is central to Christ's role as the 'Spirit of God' (Ezekiel 3:6) and the 'Light of the world' (John 1:5), where it signifies the revelation of divine truths and the empowerment of believers to discern God's will
understand.first_appearance: Genesis 11:7 (Genesis 11:7, ESV): 'Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand.'
understand.reveals_about_christ: The word 'understanding' reveals Christ's mission as a teacher and healer, emphasizing His role in imparting divine knowledge and transforming hearts through spiritual insight and the indwelling Holy Spirit
understand.major_scriptural_pattern: divine revelation and spiritual insight, emphasizing the capacity to grasp divine truths through wisdom and divine presence
understand.literal_sense: to know, to comprehend, to perceive
understand.symbolic_structure: paired terms (e.g., 'understanding' and 'knowledge'), repeated phrases (e.g., 'the spirit of God'), and numerical patterns (e.g., the number 11 in Genesis 11:7), reflecting the tension between human limitation and divine omniscience
understand.numerical_letter_observations: The root 'understand' (Greek: ) contains 11 letters, mirroring the number of people in Genesis 11:7, symbolizing divine completeness and the inclusion of all nations in God's plan
understand.semantic_range: knowledge, insight, revelation, wisdom, spiritual comprehension
